body: Grace and I, along with several other family members, had the joy of attending the Christmas Eve service at Cedar Ridge Community Church , which was our church home for 24 years. What a wonderful experience! The music was amazing, the message strong, and the spirit was beautiful. If you’re looking for a church home in the Washington-Baltimore area, you really should check out this beautiful community of faith.
